# Manitoba Education and Early Childhood Learning

> > Manitoba's official education portal providing K-12 curriculum, assessment, indigenous education frameworks, and early childhood learning resources.

This is the primary government website for Manitoba's Department of Education and Early Childhood Learning, serving educators, students, families, and administrators across the province. The site emphasizes indigenous education integration, curriculum development, school safety, and teacher professional standards.

## Key Topics

- Manitoba Education and Early Childhood Learning
- K-12 Education
- Indigenous Excellence
- Curriculum Resources
- Teacher Professional Conduct
- Provincial Assessment Program
- First Nations and Métis Integration
- School Safety and Inclusive Learning
- Student Services and Special Education
- Indigenous Inclusion Directorate
- Mam̀àhtawisiwin Framework
- Professional Teacher Certification
- School Funding and Finance
- Truth and Reconciliation
- Early Childhood Learning

## Core Education Resources

- [Kindergarten to Grade 12](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/index.html): Main K-12 education hub with curriculum and policy resources
- [Curriculum](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/cur/index.html): Curriculum overview and learning outcomes for Manitoba schools
- [Assessment and Evaluation](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/assess/index.html): Provincial assessment programs and testing schedules for K-12
- [Student Services](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/specedu/aep/index.html): Special education and appropriate educational programming services

## Indigenous Education and Reconciliation

- [Indigenous Excellence](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/iee/index.html): Indigenous education policy and truth and reconciliation initiatives
- [Mam̀àhtawisiwin: The Wonder We Are Born With](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/iid/mamahtawisiwin.html): Indigenous education policy framework for First Nations and Métis
- [Indigenous Inclusion Directorate](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/iee/about.html): About Indigenous Inclusion Directorate and cultural responsiveness mandate
- [Indigenous Identity Declaration](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/iee/abidentity.html): Indigenous identity declaration and aboriginal data collection guidelines

## School Safety and Student Support

- [Safe and Caring Schools](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/safe_schools/index.html): School safety policies and inclusive learning environment guidelines
- [Routine Practices: Guide to Creating a Healthy Environment](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/routine_practices/index.html): Guide to infection prevention and health practices in schools
- [Going to School in Manitoba](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/schools/gts.html): School enrollment, attendance, and student rights information

## Teacher Professional Standards and Certification

- [Professional Certification](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/profcert/index.html): Teacher certification and international educator credential requirements
- [The Commissioner of Teacher Professional Conduct](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/commissioner/index.html): Commissioner office handling teacher professional conduct complaints
- [Manitoba's Recruitment and Retention Strategy for French Language Teachers](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/docs/retention_teachers/index.html): French language teacher recruitment and retention strategy 2023-2026

## Education Finance and Data

- [Finance and Statistics](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/finance/schfund/index.html): School funding, budgets, and education statistics for Manitoba
- [Manitoba K-12 Education Data Dashboard](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/k12/grad_rates/index.html): Education data dashboard with graduation rates and student achievement

## Language and Accessibility

- [Education and Early Childhood Learning (French)](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/indexfr.html): French language homepage for Manitoba Education services

## Optional

- [Site Map](https://www.edu.gov.mb.ca/sitemap.html): Site navigation map for Manitoba Education website
